segments.name: Drilling equipment
segments.description: One consolidated segment designing, manufacturing, selling, renting and installing drilling and well products and services for oil and natural gas operators worldwide.
segments.evidence: We operate in one reportable segment as our chief operating decision maker ("CODM") assesses performance and allocates resources based on financial information presented at a consolidated level.

revenueModel.text: Oil and natural gas companies pay Innovex for the products it designs, manufactures and sells and for services and rental equipment it provides.
revenueModel.evidence: We design, manufacture, sell, rent and install products that are used in oil and natural gas exploration, development and production activities

changes.text: In 2024 the merger of Legacy Innovex and Dril-Quip combined the two businesses and the Dril-Quip name was changed to Innovex International.
changes.evidence: Following the Merger, Legacy Innovex became a wholly owned subsidiary of Dril-Quip, and the name "Dril-Quip, Inc." was changed to "Innovex International, Inc."
